capabilities: repeat the most recently executed command with a hotkey
show the remembered command in the status bar
configure status bar display (hidden, icon only, or icon and name)
extras: README warns the plugin instruments Obsidian's internal command manager and palette handler, so Obsidian updates may break it; commands bypassing those paths cannot be repeated. Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mobile is supported but lacks the status bar item.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to repeat the last command without reopening the command palette and finding it again.
summary: Command repeat utility that re-runs the most recently executed Obsidian command via a user-assigned hotkey.
